mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are 61 degrees at Harriet Park under a full moon. Please note the air quality is currently moderate with an index of 53. For space fans, the International Space Station will be visible tonight starting at 3:27 AM, rising in the west northwest over Cross Plains and heading northeast toward the Madison area near Home Depot.

In city news, September 2026 has been proclaimed Hunger Action Month by Mayor Diaz to tackle the systemic issue of food insecurity in our area, while also recognizing September as Suicide Prevention Month and celebrating our local building inspectors for their hard work on Building Inspector and Code Staff Appreciation Day.

There is plenty to do this weekend! Today you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market, or catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Verona Area High School hosts a Kids Triathlon and the Verona Ice Arena is offering a Girls Try Hockey event.

In our police report for the week of August 17 to August 24, on August 17, officers were dispatched to the 500 block of Cross Country Road to assist the Department of Corrections in taking a man into custody for a probation violation.
Today's flavor of the day is Mint Explosion. The store is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and grab a treat.
